title: All DB access serialized through one shared connection + global lock
evidence: bookapi/db.py:35-38 one sqlite3 connection with check_same_thread=False guarded by a single threading.Lock, so ThreadingHTTPServer threads cannot run DB work concurrently
suggestion: Acceptable and documented for this scale; a connection pool or per-thread connection would remove the serialization if throughput ever matters

title: GET /books returns the full collection with no pagination
evidence: bookapi/api.py:95-97 _search_books returns repo.search() unbounded; TASK.md does not require pagination
suggestion: Beyond spec; add ?limit/?offset only if large collections become a concern
